86:     }
87: 
88:     private fun satisfiesSingle(v: V, c: String): Boolean {
89:         if (c.isEmpty() || c == "*" || c == "x" || c == "X") return true
90:         return when {
91:             c.startsWith("^") -> caret(v, c.substring(1))
92:             c.startsWith("~>") -> tilde(v, c.substring(2)) // npm treats ~> like ~
93:             c.startsWith("~") -> tilde(v, c.substring(1))
94:             c.startsWith(">=") -> cmp(v, c.substring(2)) >= 0
95:             c.startsWith("<=") -> cmp(v, c.substring(2)) <= 0
96:             c.startsWith(">") -> cmp(v, c.substring(1)) > 0
97:             c.startsWith("<") -> cmp(v, c.substring(1)) < 0
98:             c.startsWith("=") -> cmp(v, c.substring(1)) == 0

101:     }
102: 
103:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
104: 
105:     /** compare v against a plain version spec; Int.MIN_VALUE when unparsable. */
106:     private fun cmp(v: V, spec: String): Int {
107:         val o = parse(spec) ?: return Int.MIN_VALUE
108:         return compare(v, o)
109:     }
110: 
111:     private fun lower(v: V, spec: String, orEqual: Boolean): Boolean {
112:         val c = cmp(v, spec)
113:         if (c == Int.MIN_VALUE) return false
114:         return if (orEqual) c >= 0 else c > 0
115:     }
116: 
117:     private fun upper(v: V, spec: String, orEqual: Boolean): Boolean {
118:         val c = cmp(v, spec)
119:         if (c == Int.MIN_VALUE) return false
120:         return if (orEqual) c <= 0 else c < 0
121:     }
122: 
123:     private fun exactX(v: V, spec: String): Boolean {
124:         // "1.2.3" exact, "1.2.x"/"1.2" → within 1.2.*, "1.x"/"1" → within 1.*
125:         val t = spec.trim().removePrefix("v").split('.')
126:         val nums = mutableListOf<Int>()
127:         var sawX = false
128:         for (part in t) {
129:             if (part == "x" || part == "X" || part == "*") { sawX = true; break }
130:             val n = part.toIntOrNull() ?: return false
131:             nums += n
132:         }

135:             0 -> true
136:             1 -> v.major == nums[0]
137:             2 -> v.major == nums[0] && v.minor == nums[1]
138:             else -> false
139:         }
140:     }
141: 
142:     private fun xRange(v: V, c: String) = exactX(v, c)
143: 
144:     private fun caret(v: V, spec: String): Boolean {

155:             return lower(v, spec, true) && upper(v, upperSpec, false)

188:         val t = spec.trim().removePrefix("v").split('.')

17:     class TarFormatException(message: String) : Exception(message)

19:     /** Extracts [tgz] into [destDir], stripping [stripPrefix] from entries. */
20:     fun extract(tgz: File, destDir: File, stripPrefix: String = "package/") {
21:         destDir.mkdirs()
22:         GZIPInputStream(FileInputStream(tgz)).use { gz ->
23:             val header = ByteArray(BLOCK)
24:             while (true) {
25:                 if (!readFully(gz, header)) return
26:                 if (header.all { it == 0.toByte() }) return // end-of-archive block
27:                 var name = cstr(header, 0, 100)
28:                 val size = octal(cstr(header, 124, 12))
29:                 val typeFlag = if (header[156] == 0.toByte()) '0' else header[156].toInt().toChar()
30:                 val prefix = cstr(header, 345, 155)
31:                 if (prefix.isNotEmpty()) name = "$prefix/$name"
32:                 if (name.isEmpty()) skipData(gz, size)
33: 
34:                 val data = if (size > 0) readExact(gz, size) else ByteArray(0)
35: 
36:                 val rel = strip(name, stripPrefix)
37:                 when (typeFlag) {
38:                     '0' -> {
39:                         if (rel != null) {
40:                             val out = safeFile(destDir, rel)
41:                             if (out != null) {
42:                                 out.parentFile?.mkdirs()
43:                                 out.writeBytes(data)
44:                             }
45:                         }
46:                     }
47:                     '5' -> {
48:                         if (rel != null) safeFile(destDir, rel)?.mkdirs()
49:                     }
50:                     else -> Unit // 'x'/'g' pax headers, '2' symlinks, 'L' long names: consumed, ignored
51:                 }
52:             }
53:         }
54:     }
55: 
56:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- format
57: 
58:     private fun cstr(buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, len: Int): String {
59:         var end = offset
60:         val limit = minOf(offset + len, buf.size)
61:         while (end < limit && buf[end] != 0.toByte()) end++
62:         return String(buf, offset, end - offset, Charsets.UTF_8)
63:     }
64: 
65:     private fun octal(s: String): Long {
66:         val t = s.trim(' ', '\u0000')
67:         if (t.isEmpty()) return 0L
68:         return t.toLongOrNull(radix = 8) ?: throw TarFormatException("bad tar size field: '$s'")
69:     }
70: 
71:     private fun readFully(gz: GZIPInputStream, buf: ByteArray): Boolean {
72:         var done = 0

6: /**
7:  * A clock that cannot be moved back.
8:  *
9:  * A license is only as good as the time it is checked against: `nbf` and `exp`
10:  * are signed, but both are compared to the device clock, and that clock belongs

16:  *
17:  * * the wall clock, when it is at or above the floor;
18:  * * `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()` — milliseconds since boot, which only ever
19:  *   counts up and is not settable — added to the floor, so a reboot cannot
20:  *   rewind it either.
21:  *
22:  * What remains possible is wiping the app's data, which also erases the key.
23:  * That is the honest limit of an offline scheme with no server.
24:  */
25: class MonotonicClock(
26:     private val wallClock: () -> Long = { System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000 },
27:     private val uptimeMillis: () -> Long = { SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() },
28:     private val store: Store,
29: ) {
30: 
31:     interface Store {
32:         /** The remembered floor and the uptime at the moment it was written. */
33:         fun read(): Saved?
34: 
35:         fun write(saved: Saved)
36:     }
37: 
38:     data class Saved(val epochSeconds: Long, val uptimeMillis: Long)
39: 
40:     /**
41:      * The time to verify a license against. Never below anything this app has
42:      * already observed, and never below the floor advanced by the boot clock.
43:      */
44:     fun now(): Long {
45:         val wall = wallClock()
46:         val uptime = uptimeMillis()
47:         val saved = store.read()
48:         val floor = when {
49:             saved == null -> wall
50:             // A reboot drops elapsedRealtime to zero; the wall clock carries it
51:             // across, and the saved floor is still the hard minimum.
52:             uptime >= saved.uptimeMillis ->
53:                 maxOf(saved.epochSeconds, saved.epochSeconds + (uptime - saved.uptimeMillis) / 1000)
54: 
55:             else -> saved.epochSeconds
56:         }
57:         val result = maxOf(wall, floor)
58:         if (saved == null || result > saved.epochSeconds) {
59:             store.write(Saved(result, uptime))

 *   counts up and is not settable — added to the floor, so a reboot cannot
 *   rewind it either.

31:             throw ParseException("ответ GitHub не разобран")

34:         val tag = release.optString("tag_name").ifBlank {
35:             throw ParseException("в релизе нет тега")
36:         }
37:         val assets = release.optJSONArray("assets")
38:             ?: throw ParseException("в релизе нет вложений")

40:         for (i in 0 until assets.length()) {
41:             val asset = assets.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
42:             val name = asset.optString("name")
43:             if (!name.endsWith(".apk")) continue
44:             if (name.endsWith(APK_SUFFIX)) {
45:                 chosen = asset
46:                 break
47:             }
48:             // A release whose file is named differently is still installable;
49:             // a debug build is not, it is a separate app.
50:             if (chosen == null && !name.contains("debug")) chosen = asset
51:         }
52:         val asset = chosen ?: throw ParseException("в релизе нет APK для установки")
53:         val url = asset.optString("browser_download_url").ifBlank { asset.optString("url") }
54:         if (url.isBlank()) throw ParseException("у APK в релизе нет ссылки")
55:         return ReleaseInfo(
56:             tag = tag,
57:             version = version(tag),
58:             notes = release.optString("body").trim(),
59:             asset = ReleaseInfo.Asset(
60:                 name = asset.optString("name"),
61:                 url = url,
62:                 size = asset.optLong("size", 0L),
63:             ),
64:         )
65:     }
66:

69:      * build's own versionName comes from the nearest tag (build.gradle.kts), so
70:      * comparing the two needs nothing but this.
71:      */
72:     fun version(tag: String): String = tag.trim()
73:         .removePrefix("v")
74:         .removePrefix("V")
75:         .substringBefore('-')
76:         .substringBefore('+')
77:         .trim()
78: 
79:     /**
80:      * True when [candidate] is strictly newer than [installed]. A prerelease
81:      * suffix (`-rc1`) is not read as a number and does not make anything newer
82:      * than the release it precedes; GitHub keeps prereleases out of /latest
83:      * anyway.
84:      */
85:     fun isNewer(candidate: String, installed: String): Boolean {
86:         val left = parts(candidate)
87:         val right = parts(installed)
88:         val size = maxOf(left.size, right.size)
89:         for (i in 0 until size) {

91:             val b = right.getOrElse(i) { 0L }
92:             if (a != b) return a > b
93:         }
94:         return false
95:     }

98:         .map { it.takeWhile(Char::isDigit) }
99:         .map { if (it.isEmpty()) 0L else it.toLong() }
100: }

MonotonicClock: potential bug. `now()`:
```
uptime >= saved.uptimeMillis -> maxOf(saved.epochSeconds, saved.epochSeconds + (uptime - saved.uptimeMillis)/1000)
```
maxOf(saved.epochSeconds, saved.epochSeconds + delta) = saved.epochSeconds + delta since delta>=0. So effectively floor = saved.epoch + delta. Fine. Result = max(wall, floor). Write if saved==null || result > saved.epochSeconds. Fine.

But consider uptime < saved.uptimeMillis (reboot). floor = saved.epochSeconds. result = max(wall, saved.epochSeconds). Fine.

Potential issue: `prefs` in anonymous object used `getSharedPreferences` on `this` (the Context). Since store created as `context.applicationContext.preferences()`, the receiver is applicationContext. Fine.

LicenseManager: not synchronized. activate/evaluate state. Minor.

AppUpdater: `download` - `partial.outputStream().buffered().use` - outputStream closed. Fine.

AppUpdate.isNewer: `parts` uses takeWhile digits. For version "1.5.0" fine. `isNewer` compares. Fine.

AppUpdate.parse: chooses asset. Potential bug: `if (chosen == null && !name.contains("debug")) chosen = asset` — if a release has both a debug apk first and a release apk later with the APK_SUFFIX, the code sets chosen to non-debug first, but then continues loop; if it later finds APK_SUFFIX it sets chosen and breaks. Good. If release apk comes first, breaks. Fine.

AppUpdate.version: substringBefore('-') - strips prerelease. Fine.

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    /**
     * Model rounds per user request. Each round is one model call plus the
     * tools it asked for, so a real task (edit a project, push it, wait for the
     * CI run, fix what broke) needs dozens of them — the old default of 12
     * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

15:  *
16:  * Three things matter for a mobile agent loop and are implemented here:
17:  *
18:  * * **Streaming.** The request asks for `stream: true` and the answer is read
19:  *   as SSE, so a generation that takes many minutes keeps the connection busy
20:  *   (idle connections get killed by gateways and mobile networks), the ⏹ button
21:  *   is honoured between chunks, and the UI can show what is being written. A
22:  *   server that answers with a plain JSON body instead is handled transparently.
23:  * * **Retries.** Timeouts, resets, 429 and 5xx are retried with a backoff;
24:  *   everything else (bad key, unknown model) fails immediately.
25:  * * **Long deadlines.** A model that thinks for a long time must not lose the
26:  *   turn: the read timeout is 15 minutes, and a watchdog aborts a connection
27:  *   that goes silent for much longer than that.
28:  */
29: class LlmClient(private val config: AgentSettings.Config) {
30: 
31:     data class ToolCall(val id: String, val name: String, val arguments: String)
32:     data class Response(val content: String?, val toolCalls: List<ToolCall>)
33: 
34:     class LlmException(message: String) : Exception(message)
35: 
36:     /** The server answered, but not in a form we can use — worth one plain retry. */
37:     private class UnusableAnswer(val detail: String) : Exception(detail)
38: 
39:     /** A non-2xx answer, kept structured so retries can look at the status. */
40:     private class HttpFailure(val status: Int, val body: String) : Exception("HTTP $status")
41: 
42:     companion object {
43:         const val CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
44: 
45:         /** 15 minutes — a long generation must not lose the turn. */
46:         const val READ_TIMEOUT_MS = 900_000
47: 
48:         /** No bytes for this long (and none at all since the request) = dead connection. */
49:         const val FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 240_000
50: 
51:         /** A stream that goes quiet for this long after the first token is dead too. */
52:         const val STALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000
53: 
54:         const val MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
55:         const val RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = 3_000L
56:         const val CANCELLED = "остановлено пользователем"
57: 
58:         private const val SSE_DATA = "data:"
59:         private const val SSE_DONE = "[DONE]"
60: 
61:         /**
62:          * Fetches the model list of an OpenAI-compatible server:
63:          * GET {baseUrl}/models, parse data[].id. Used by the model settings UI
64:          * (e.g. the OpenCode Zen catalog at https://opencode.ai/zen/v1).
65:          */
66:         fun models(baseUrl: String, apiKey: String): List<String> {
67:             val url = baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/') + "/models"
68:             val conn = (URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
69:                 requestMethod = "GET"
70:                 connectTimeout = 20_000
71:                 readTimeout = 60_000
72:                 setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
73:                 if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
74:             }
75:             try {
76:                 val status = conn.responseCode
77:                 val text = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
78:                     ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
79:                 if (status !in 200..299) {
80:                     throw LlmException("HTTP $status от $url: ${text.take(300)}")
81:                 }
82:                 val data = JSONObject(text).optJSONArray("data") ?: return emptyList()
83:                 val ids = mutableListOf<String>()
84:                 for (i in 0 until data.length()) {
85:                     val id = data.optJSONObject(i)?.optString("id").orEmpty()
86:                     if (id.isNotEmpty()) ids += id
87:                 }
88:                 return ids.sortedWith(compareBy<String> { it.lowercase() })
89:             } finally {
90:                 conn.disconnect()
91:             }
92:         }
93: 
94:         /**
95:          * Accumulates an OpenAI-style SSE stream: text deltas plus tool calls
96:          * whose name and arguments arrive in pieces. Kept separate from the
97:          * socket code so it can be tested without a server.
98:          */
99:         internal class Stream(
100:             private val onDelta: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
101:         ) {
102:             private val text = StringBuilder()
103:             private val reasoning = StringBuilder()
104:             private val calls = LinkedHashMap<Int, Call>()
105: 
106:             private class Call {
107:                 var id: String = ""
108:                 var name: String = ""
109:                 val arguments = StringBuilder()
110:             }
111: 
112:             /** Feeds one `data:` payload; malformed chunks are ignored. */
113:             fun feed(payload: String) {
114:                 val json = try {
115:                     JSONObject(payload)
116:                 } catch (t: Throwable) {
117:                     return
118:                 }
119:                 json.optJSONObject("error")?.let { err ->
120:                     val msg = err.optString("message").ifEmpty { payload.take(200) }
121:                     throw LlmException("сервер модели вернул ошибку: $msg")
122:                 }
123:                 val choice = json.optJSONArray("choices")?.optJSONObject(0) ?: return
124:                 // `delta` for streams, `message` for servers that stream nothing.
125:                 val delta = choice.optJSONObject("delta") ?: choice.optJSONObject("message") ?: return
126:                 delta.optString("content").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let {
127:                     text.append(it)
128:                     onDelta?.invoke(it)
129:                 }
130:                 // Reasoning models stream their thinking separately; keep it so a
131:                 // blank `content` still produces something useful.
132:                 delta.optString("reasoning_content").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { reasoning.append(it) }
133:                 val arr = delta.optJSONArray("tool_calls") ?: return
134:                 for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
135:                     val chunk = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
136:                     val slot = calls.getOrPut(chunk.optInt("index", i)) { Call() }
137:                     chunk.optString("id").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { slot.id = it }
138:                     val fn = chunk.optJSONObject("function") ?: continue
139:                     fn.optString("name").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let {
140:                         slot.name = if (slot.name.isEmpty()) it else slot.name + it
141:                     }
142:                     fn.optString("arguments").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { slot.arguments.append(it) }
143:                 }
144:             }
145: 
146:             fun isEmpty(): Boolean = text.isBlank() && reasoning.isBlank() && calls.isEmpty()
147: 
148:             /**
149:              * The finished answer. A well-formed but empty stream yields an
150:              * empty [Response] on purpose: the agent nudges the model and spends
151:              * one round, which beats three retries of a request that will not
152:              * change. Only a structurally broken answer is an error.
153:              */
154:             fun result(): Response {
155:                 val toolCalls = calls.entries.sortedBy { it.key }.map { (i, c) ->
156:                     ToolCall(
157:                         id = c.id.ifEmpty { "call_$i" },
158:                         name = c.name,
159:                         arguments = c.arguments.toString().ifBlank { "{}" },
160:                     )
161:                 }.filter { it.name.isNotEmpty() }
162:                 val content = text.toString().ifBlank { reasoning.toString() }.ifBlank { null }
163:                 return Response(content, toolCalls)
164:             }
165:         }
166: 
167:         /** Turns a streamed or plain assistant message into [Response]. */
168:         internal fun parseMessage(message: JSONObject): Response {
169:             val content = if (message.isNull("content")) {
170:                 null
171:             } else {
172:                 message.optString("content").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
173:             }
174:             val calls = mutableListOf<ToolCall>()
175:             val arr = message.optJSONArray("tool_calls")
176:             if (arr != null) {
177:                 for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
178:                     val call = arr.getJSONObject(i)
179:                     val fn = call.optJSONObject("function") ?: continue
180:                     val name = fn.optString("name")
181:                     if (name.isEmpty()) continue
182:                     calls += ToolCall(
183:                         id = call.optString("id").ifEmpty { "call_$i" },
184:                         name = name,
185:                         arguments = fn.optString("arguments", "{}").ifEmpty { "{}" },
186:                     )
187:                 }
188:             }
189:             return Response(content, calls)
190:         }
191: 
192:         /** A user-readable, actionable description of a failed request. */
193:         internal fun describe(t: Throwable): String = when (t) {
194:             is LlmException -> t.message ?: "ошибка модели"
195:             is HttpFailure -> {
196:                 val hint = when (t.status) {
197:                     401 -> " — ключ отвергнут сервером"
198:                     403 -> " — доступ запрещён (у Zen нужен бесплатный ключ с opencode.ai/auth)"
199:                     404 -> " — нет такого endpoint или модели"
200:                     413 -> " — запрос слишком велик (история разрослась)"
201:                     429 -> " — лимит запросов, попробуйте позже"
202:                     in 500..599 -> " — сервер модели перегружен"
203:                     else -> ""
204:                 }
205:                 "HTTP ${t.status}$hint: ${t.body.take(300)}"
206:             }
207:             is SocketTimeoutException ->
208:                 "модель не ответила за ${READ_TIMEOUT_MS / 60_000} мин — попробуйте другую модель или упростите запрос"
209:             is IOException -> t.message ?: "сетевая ошибка: ${t.javaClass.simpleName}"
210:             else -> t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName
211:         }
212: 
213:         internal fun isRetryable(t: Throwable): Boolean = when (t) {
214:             is SocketTimeoutException, is IOException -> true
215:             is HttpFailure -> t.status == 408 || t.status == 429 || t.status in 500..599
216:             is UnusableAnswer -> true
217:             else -> false
218:         }
219:     }
220: 
221:     /**
222:      * One chat completion. [onDelta] receives text pieces as they arrive so the
223:      * UI can show progress; [isCancelled] is polled between chunks and before
224:      * every retry, which is what makes ⏹ stop a running turn.
225:      */
226:     fun chat(
227:         messages: JSONArray,
228:         tools: JSONArray?,
229:         isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
230:         onDelta: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
231:     ): Response {
232:         var attempt = 0
233:         var stream = true
234:         var backoff = RETRY_BACKOFF_MS
235:         while (true) {
236:             if (isCancelled()) throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
237:             attempt++
238:             try {
239:                 return request(messages, tools, stream, isCancelled, if (stream) onDelta else null)
240:             } catch (t: Throwable) {
241:                 if (isCancelled()) throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
242:                 // The server ignored `stream` (or answered with something odd):
243:                 // spend the same attempt on a plain, non-streamed request.
244:                 if (t is UnusableAnswer && stream) {
245:                     stream = false
246:                     attempt--
247:                     continue
248:                 }
249:                 if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || !isRetryable(t)) throw LlmException(describe(t))
250:                 nap(backoff, isCancelled)
251:                 backoff *= 2
252:             }
253:         }
254:     }
255: 
256:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- request
257: 
258:     private fun request(
259:         messages: JSONArray,
260:         tools: JSONArray?,
261:         stream: Boolean,
262:         isCancelled: () -> Boolean,
263:         onDelta: ((String) -> Unit)?,
264:     ): Response {
265:         val body = JSONObject().apply {
266:             put("model", config.model)
267:             put("messages", messages)
268:             put("temperature", 0.2)
269:             if (tools != null && tools.length() > 0) {
270:                 put("tools", tools)
271:                 put("tool_choice", "auto")
272:             }
273:             if (stream) put("stream", true)
274:         }
275: 
276:         val conn = (URL(config.endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
277:             requestMethod = "POST"
278:             connectTimeout = CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
279:             readTimeout = READ_TIMEOUT_MS
280:             doOutput = true
281:             setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
282:             setRequestProperty("Accept", if (stream) "text/event-stream, application/json" else "application/json")
283:             // No Authorization header without a key: local servers reject
284:             // stray headers far less often than cloud ones reject bad keys.
285:             if (config.apiKey.isNotBlank()) {
286:                 setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer ${config.apiKey}")
287:             }
288:         }
289:         val watchdog = Watchdog(conn)
290:         watchdog.start()
291:         try {
292:             conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
293:             val status = conn.responseCode
294:             if (status !in 200..299) {
295:                 throw HttpFailure(status, readText(conn.errorStream))
296:             }
297:             watchdog.beat()
298:             return readAnswer(conn, watchdog, isCancelled, onDelta)
299:         } catch (e: IOException) {
300:             if (watchdog.fired) throw SocketTimeoutException("нет данных от сервера модели")
301:             throw e
302:         } finally {
303:             watchdog.stop()
304:             conn.disconnect()
305:         }
306:     }
307: 
308:     /**
309:      * Reads the answer line by line: SSE chunks when the server streams them,
310:      * otherwise the whole body as one JSON document.
311:      */
312:     private fun readAnswer(
313:         conn: HttpURLConnection,
314:         watchdog: Watchdog,
315:         isCancelled: () -> Boolean,
316:         onDelta: ((String) -> Unit)?,
317:     ): Response {
318:         val reader = conn.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)
319:         val stream = Stream(onDelta)
320:         val plain = StringBuilder()
321:         var sawChunk = false
322:         while (true) {
323:             if (isCancelled()) throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
324:             val line = reader.readLine() ?: break
325:             if (line.isBlank()) continue
326:             if (line.startsWith(SSE_DATA)) {
327:                 sawChunk = true
328:                 val payload = line.removePrefix(SSE_DATA).trim()
329:                 if (payload == SSE_DONE) break
330:                 stream.feed(payload)
331:             } else if (!sawChunk) {
332:                 // Not a stream: accumulate the plain JSON body.
333:                 plain.append(line)
334:             }
335:             watchdog.beat()
336:         }
337:         if (sawChunk) return stream.result()
338:         val body = plain.toString().trim()
339:         if (body.isEmpty()) throw UnusableAnswer("сервер вернул пустой ответ")
340:         val json = try {
341:             JSONObject(body)
342:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
343:             throw UnusableAnswer("ожидался JSON, получено: ${body.take(120)}")
344:         }
345:         json.optJSONObject("error")?.let { err ->
346:             throw LlmException("сервер модели вернул ошибку: ${err.optString("message").ifEmpty { body.take(200) }}")
347:         }
348:         val choices = json.optJSONArray("choices")
349:         if (choices == null || choices.length() == 0) throw UnusableAnswer("в ответе нет choices: ${body.take(200)}")
350:         return parseMessage(choices.getJSONObject(0).getJSONObject("message"))
351:     }
352: 
353:     private fun readText(stream: java.io.InputStream?): String =
354:         stream?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
355: 
356:     /** Interruptible backoff between retries. */
357:     private fun nap(ms: Long, isCancelled: () -> Boolean) {
358:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + ms
359:         while (System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
360:             if (isCancelled()) throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
361:             try {
362:                 Thread.sleep(250)
363:             } catch (e: InterruptedException) {
364:                 Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
365:                 throw LlmException(CANCELLED)
366:             }
367:         }
368:     }
369: 
370:     /**
371:      * Closes a connection that stopped delivering bytes. HttpURLConnection's
372:      * read timeout is a per-read value, so a server that stops mid-answer would
373:      * otherwise hold the turn for the full deadline.
374:      */
375:     private class Watchdog(private val conn: HttpURLConnection) {
376:         private val lastData = AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis())
377:         private val gotData = AtomicBoolean(false)
378: 
379:         /** True when the watchdog, not the server, ended the connection. */
380:         @Volatile
381:         var fired: Boolean = false
382: 
383:         @Volatile
384:         private var stopped: Boolean = false
385: 
386:         fun start() {
387:             Thread({
388:                 while (!stopped) {
389:                     Thread.sleep(2_000)
390:                     if (stopped) return@Thread
391:                     val idle = System.currentTimeMillis() - lastData.get()
392:                     val limit = if (gotData.get()) STALL_TIMEOUT_MS else FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS
393:                     if (idle > limit) {
394:                         fired = true
395:                         runCatching { conn.disconnect() }
396:                         return@Thread
397:                     }
398:                 }
399:             }, "llm-watchdog").apply {
400:                 isDaemon = true
401:                 start()
402:             }
403:         }
404: 
405:         /** Called for every piece of data that arrived. */
406:         fun beat() {
407:             lastData.set(System.currentTimeMillis())
408:             gotData.set(true)
409:         }
410: 
411:         fun stop() {
412:             stopped = true
413:         }
414:     }
415: }

140:         // A hunk with no '-' and only '+' inserts after its context (or at start).
141:         // A hunk with '-' replaces the removed block with its added line(s).
142:         var lines = text.split('\n').toMutableList()
143:         // drop a single trailing empty element produced by a trailing \n
144:         val hadTrailingNewline = text.endsWith("\n")
145:         if (hadTrailingNewline && lines.isNotEmpty() && lines.last().isEmpty()) lines.removeAt(lines.lastIndex)
146: 
147:         for (hunk in hunks.filter { it.hasChanges }) {
148:             if (hunk.removed.isEmpty()) {
149:                 // pure insertion: after contextBefore (or at file start when no context)
150:                 val anchor = hunk.contextBefore.lastOrNull()
151:                 val at = if (anchor == null) 0 else indexOfLine(lines, anchor, 0, path) + 1
152:                 lines.addAll(at, hunk.added)
153:             } else {
154:                 val at = indexOfBlock(lines, hunk.removed, path)
155:                 lines.subList(at, at + hunk.removed.size).clear()
156:                 lines.addAll(at, hunk.added)
157:             }
158:         }
159:         return lines.joinToString("\n") + if (hadTrailingNewline) "\n" else ""
160:     }
161: 
162:     private fun indexOfLine(lines: List<String>, needle: String, from: Int, path: String): Int {
163:         for (i in from until lines.size) if (lineMatches(lines[i], needle)) return i
164:         throw PatchException("Update File $path: контекст '$needle' не найден")
165:     }
166: 
167:     private fun indexOfBlock(lines: List<String>, block: List<String>, path: String): Int {
168:         outer@ for (i in 0..lines.size - block.size) {
169:             for (j in block.indices) if (!lineMatches(lines[i + j], block[j])) continue@outer
170:             return i
171:         }
172:         throw PatchException("Update File $path: блок не найден: ${block.firstOrNull() ?: ""}")
173:     }
174: 
175:     /**
176:      * Context/removed lines match the file exactly, or modulo one leading
177:      * space on the patch side (models often send diff-style context lines).
178:      */
179:     private fun lineMatches(fileLine: String, patchLine: String): Boolean =
180:         fileLine == patchLine ||
181:             (patchLine.startsWith(" ") && fileLine == patchLine.substring(1))
182: }

55:             xargs, diff, wget, ...) выполняется как настоящий бинарник.
56:             Поддерживаются кавычки, && , | и > >> для встроенных команд.
57:         """.trimIndent()
58:     }

60:     data class Result(val exitCode: Int, val output: String) {
61:         val ok: Boolean get() = exitCode == 0
62:     }

64:     /** Executes [commandLine] with [cwd] as the working directory. */
65:     fun execute(commandLine: String, cwd: File, timeoutMs: Long = OpenCodeTools.BASH_TIMEOUT_MS): Result {
66:         var dir = if (cwd.isDirectory) cwd else workspace.root
67:         val segments = splitAnd(commandLine)
68:         if (segments.isEmpty()) return Result(0, "")
69:         val out = StringBuilder()
70:         var lastExit = 0
71:         for (segment in segments) {
72:             if (lastExit != 0) break
73:             val r = runPipeline(segment, dir, timeoutMs) { d -> dir = d }
74:             out.append(r.output)
75:             lastExit = r.exitCode
76:         }
77:         return Result(lastExit, cap(out.toString()))
78:     }

80:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- structure
81: 
82:     /** Splits on && at top level (outside quotes). */
83:     private fun splitAnd(line: String): List<String> {
84:         val parts = mutableListOf<String>()
85:         val cur = StringBuilder()
86:         var quote: Char? = null
87:         var i = 0
88:         while (i < line.length) {
89:             val c = line[i]
90:             when {
91:                 quote != null -> {
92:                     cur.append(c)
93:                     if (c == quote) quote = null
94:                 }
95:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; cur.append(c) }
96:                 c == '&' && i + 1 < line.length && line[i + 1] == '&' -> {
97:                     if (cur.isNotBlank()) parts += cur.toString().trim()
98:                     cur.clear()
99:                     i++
100:                 }
101:                 else -> cur.append(c)
102:             }
103:             i++
104:         }
105:         if (cur.isNotBlank()) parts += cur.toString().trim()
106:         return parts
107:     }

109:     /** Runs one `cmd | cmd | cmd [> file]` pipeline segment. */
110:     private fun runPipeline(
111:         segment: String,
112:         dir: File,
113:         timeoutMs: Long,
114:         onCd: (File) -> Unit,
115:     ): Result {
116:         // split on top-level |
117:         val stages = mutableListOf<String>()
118:         val cur = StringBuilder()
119:         var quote: Char? = null
120:         var i = 0
121:         while (i < segment.length) {
122:             val c = segment[i]
123:             when {
124:                 quote != null -> { cur.append(c); if (c == quote) quote = null }
125:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; cur.append(c) }
126:                 c == '|' -> { stages += cur.toString().trim(); cur.clear() }
127:                 else -> cur.append(c)
128:             }
129:             i++
130:         }
131:         if (cur.isNotBlank()) stages += cur.toString().trim()
132:         if (stages.isEmpty()) return Result(0, "")
133: 
134:         var input = ""
135:         var exit = 0
136:         var redirectFile: File? = null
137:         var append = false
138: 
139:         for ((index, stage) in stages.withIndex()) {
140:             val (tokens, redir, redirAppend) = extractRedirect(tokenize(stage), dir)
141:             redirectFile = redir
142:             append = redirAppend
143:             if (tokens.isEmpty()) continue
144:             val cmd = tokens[0]
145:             val args = tokens.drop(1)
146: 
147:             // runtime commands ignore stdin/pipes — they run to completion
148:             val r = when (cmd) {
149:                 "python", "python3" -> runPython(args, dir, timeoutMs)
150:                 "node" -> runNode(args, dir, timeoutMs)
151:                 "npx" -> runNpx(args, dir, timeoutMs)
152:                 "npm" -> npm(args, dir, timeoutMs)
153:                 else -> runBuiltin(cmd, args, dir, input, onCd)
154:             }
155:             exit = r.exitCode
156:             input = r.output
157:             // redirect only applies to the last stage
158:             if (index == stages.lastIndex) {
159:                 if (redirectFile != null) {
160:                     writeToFile(redirectFile, input, append)
161:                     return Result(r.exitCode, "")
162:                 }
163:             }
164:         }
165:         return Result(exit, input)
166:     }
167: 
168:     /** `> file` / `>> file` on built-in commands. */
169:     private fun extractRedirect(tokens: List<String>, dir: File): Triple<List<String>, File?, Boolean> {
170:         val gt = tokens.indexOfFirst { it == ">" || it == ">>" }
171:         if (gt < 0 || gt + 1 >= tokens.size) return Triple(tokens, null, false)
172:         val file = sandboxPath(tokens[gt + 1], dir)
173:         return Triple(tokens.subList(0, gt), file, tokens[gt] == ">>")
174:     }

176:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- builtins

178:     private fun runBuiltin(cmd: String, args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String, onCd: (File) -> Unit): Result {
179:         return when (cmd) {
180:             "pwd" -> Result(0, dir.relativeToOrNull(workspace.root)?.let { "./$it" } ?: dir.absolutePath + "\n")
181:             "cd" -> {
182:                 val target = sandboxPath(args.firstOrNull() ?: ".", dir)
183:                 if (target == null || !target.isDirectory) Result(1, "cd: ${args.firstOrNull() ?: ""}: нет такого каталога\n")
184:                 else { onCd(target); Result(0, "") }
185:             }
186:             "ls" -> ls(args, dir)
187:             "cat" -> cat(args, dir, stdin)
188:             "echo" -> Result(0, args.joinToString(" ") + "\n")
189:             "mkdir" -> mkdir(args, dir)
190:             "rm" -> rm(args, dir)
191:             "mv" -> mv(args, dir)
192:             "cp" -> cp(args, dir)
193:             "touch" -> {
194:                 var ok = 0
195:                 for (a in flagsFree(args)) {
196:                     val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
197:                     if (f == null) { ok = 1; continue }
198:                     if (f.exists()) f.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis()) else f.createNewFile()
199:                 }
200:                 Result(ok, "")
201:             }
202:             "head" -> headTail(args, dir, fromStart = true)
203:             "tail" -> headTail(args, dir, fromStart = false)
204:             "wc" -> wc(args, dir, stdin)
205:             "find" -> find(args, dir)
206:             "grep" -> shellGrep(args, dir, stdin)
207:             "env" -> Result(0, "HOME=${workspace.root.absolutePath}\nLANG=C.UTF-8\n")
208:             "date" -> Result(0, SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss yyyy", Locale.US).format(Date()) + "\n")
209:             "sleep" -> {
210:                 val sec = args.firstOrNull()?.toFloatOrNull() ?: return Result(1, "sleep: нужен аргумент в секундах\n")
211:                 if (sec > MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS) return Result(1, "sleep: максимум ${MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS.toInt()} секунд\n")
212:                 if (sec > 0) Thread.sleep((sec * 1000).toLong())
213:                 Result(0, "")
214:             }
215:             "uname" -> Result(0, "Linux aarch64 PocketRun\n")
216:             "which" -> {
217:                 val name = args.firstOrNull()
218:                 when {
219:                     name == null -> Result(1, "")
220:                     name in COMMANDS -> Result(0, "/bin/$name\n")
221:                     busybox?.knowsApplet(name) == true -> Result(0, "${busybox.binaryPath} $name\n")
222:                     else -> Result(1, "")
223:                 }
224:             }
225:             "true" -> Result(0, "")
226:             "false" -> Result(1, "")
227:             "help" -> Result(0, HELP + "\n")
228:             else -> runExternal(cmd, args, dir, stdin)
229:         }
230:     }

232:     /** Falls back to a real BusyBox applet for anything the built-ins lack. */
233:     private fun runExternal(cmd: String, args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
234:         val bb = busybox
235:         if (bb != null && bb.isAvailable() && bb.knowsApplet(cmd)) {
236:             val r = bb.run(listOf(cmd) + args, dir, stdin, BUSYBOX_TIMEOUT_MS)
237:             return Result(r.exitCode, r.stdout + (if (r.stderr.isNotBlank()) r.stderr else ""))
238:         }
239:         val hint = if (bb != null && bb.isAvailable()) {
240:             " (встроенные: ${COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")}; плюс любой applet busybox)"
241:         } else {
242:             " (доступно: ${COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")})"
243:         }
244:         return Result(127, "bash: $cmd: команда не найдена$hint\n")
245:     }

247:     private fun flagsFree(args: List<String>): List<String> = args.filter { !it.startsWith("-") }

249:     private fun ls(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
250:         val all = args.any { it == "-a" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" }
251:         val long = args.any { it == "-l" || it == "-la" || it == "-al" || it == "-lh" }
252:         val targets = flagsFree(args).ifEmpty { listOf(".") }
253:         val out = StringBuilder()
254:         var exit = 0
255:         for (t in targets) {
256:             val f = sandboxPath(t, dir)
257:             if (f == null || !f.exists()) { exit = 1; out.append("ls: $t: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
258:             val entries = when {
259:                 f.isDirectory -> f.listFiles()?.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() } ?: emptyList()
260:                 else -> listOf(f)
261:             }.filter { all || !it.name.startsWith(".") }
262:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("${t}:\n")
263:             for (e in entries) {
264:                 if (long) {
265:                     out.append("%s %8d  %s\n".format(if (e.isDirectory()) "d" else "-", e.length(), e.name))
266:                 } else {
267:                     out.append(if (e.isDirectory()) e.name + "/" else e.name)
268:                     out.append("\n")
269:                 }
270:             }
271:             if (targets.size > 1) out.append("\n")
272:         }
273:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
274:     }

276:     private fun cat(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
277:         if (args.isEmpty() || args.first() == "-") return Result(0, stdin)
278:         val out = StringBuilder()
279:         var exit = 0
280:         for (a in args) {
281:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
282:             if (f == null || !f.isFile) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
283:             if (f.length() > MAX_FILE) { exit = 1; out.append("cat: $a: файл слишком большой\n"); continue }
284:             out.append(f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
285:         }
286:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
287:     }

289:     private fun mkdir(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
290:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-p" }
291:         var exit = 0
292:         val out = StringBuilder()
293:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {
294:             val f = sandboxPath(a, dir)
295:             if (f == null) { exit = 1; continue }
296:             if (f.exists()) {
297:                 if (!recursive) { exit = 1; out.append("mkdir: $a: уже существует\n") }
298:                 continue
299:             }
300:             if (recursive) f.mkdirs() else f.mkdir()
301:             if (!f.isDirectory) { exit = 1; out.append("mkdir: $a: не удалось создать\n") }
302:         }
303:         return Result(exit, out.toString())
304:     }

306:     private fun rm(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
307:         val recursive = args.any { it == "-r" || it == "-rf" || it == "-fr" || it == "-R" }
308:         var exit = 0
309:         val out = StringBuilder()
310:         for (a in flagsFree(args)) {

312:             if (f == null || !f.exists()) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: нет такого файла\n"); continue }
313:             if (f.isDirectory && !recursive) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: это каталог (нужен -r)\n"); continue }
314:             if (!f.deleteRecursively()) { exit = 1; out.append("rm: $a: не удалось удалить\n") }
315:         }
316:         return Result(exit, out.toString())

319:     private fun mv(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
320:         val files = flagsFree(args)
321:         if (files.size < 2) return Result(1, "mv: использование: mv <откуда> <куда>\n")
322:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
323:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "mv: путь вне песочницы\n")
324:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "mv: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
325:         val target = if (to.isDirectory) File(to, from.name) else to
326:         target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
327:         return if (from.renameTo(target)) Result(0, "") else Result(1, "mv: не удалось переместить\n")
328:     }

330:     private fun cp(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
331:         val files = flagsFree(args)
332:         if (files.size < 2) return Result(1, "cp: использование: cp <откуда> <куда>\n")
333:         val from = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
334:         val to = sandboxPath(files[1], dir) ?: return Result(1, "cp: путь вне песочницы\n")
335:         if (!from.exists()) return Result(1, "cp: ${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
336:         val target = if (to.isDirectory) File(to, from.name) else to
337:         return try {
338:             if (from.isDirectory) from.copyRecursively(target, overwrite = true)
339:             else { target.parentFile?.mkdirs(); from.copyTo(target, overwrite = true) }
340:             Result(0, "")
341:         } catch (t: Throwable) { Result(1, "cp: ${t.message}\n") }
342:     }

344:     private fun headTail(args: List<String>, dir: File, fromStart: Boolean): Result {
345:         // head [-n N] [-N] file — `head -n 5 f`, `head -5 f`, `head f` all work.
346:         var n = 10
347:         val files = mutableListOf<String>()
348:         var i = 0
349:         while (i < args.size) {
350:             when {
351:                 args[i] == "-n" && i + 1 < args.size && args[i + 1].toIntOrNull() != null ->
352:                     n = args[++i].toInt()
353:                 args[i].startsWith("-") && args[i].removePrefix("-").toIntOrNull() != null ->
354:                     n = args[i].removePrefix("-").toInt()
355:                 !args[i].startsWith("-") -> files += args[i]
356:             }
357:             i++
358:         }
359:         if (files.isEmpty()) return Result(1, "${if (fromStart) "head" else "tail"}: нужен файл\n")
360:         val f = sandboxPath(files[0], dir) ?: return Result(1, "путь вне песочницы\n")
361:         if (!f.isFile) return Result(1, "${files[0]}: нет такого файла\n")
362:         val lines = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).lines()
363:         val picked = if (fromStart) lines.take(n) else lines.takeLast(n)
364:         return Result(0, picked.joinToString("\n") + "\n")
365:     }

367:     private fun wc(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
368:         val files = flagsFree(args)
369:         val text = when {
370:             files.isEmpty() -> stdin
371:             else -> sandboxPath(files.last(), dir)?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
372:                 ?: return Result(1, "wc: ${files.last()}: нет такого файла\n")
373:         }
374:         // A trailing newline does not start a new line (like wc -l).
375:         val lines = text.lines().let { if (text.endsWith("\n")) it.dropLast(1) else it }
376:         return Result(0, "%7d %7d %7d\n".format(lines.size, text.split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotEmpty() }, text.length))
377:     }

379:     private fun find(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
380:         // find [path] [-name pattern] [-type f|d]
381:         var start = dir
382:         var namePattern: String? = null
383:         var type: Char? = null
384:         var i = 0
385:         while (i < args.size) {
386:             when (args[i]) {
387:                 "-name" -> { if (i + 1 < args.size) namePattern = args[++i] }
388:                 "-type" -> { if (i + 1 < args.size) type = args[++i].firstOrNull() }
389:                 else -> if (!args[i].startsWith("-")) start = sandboxPath(args[i], dir) ?: start
390:             }
391:             i++
392:         }
393:         val out = StringBuilder()
394:         start.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
395:             if (out.length > MAX_OUTPUT) return@forEach
396:             if (type == 'f' && !f.isFile) return@forEach
397:             if (type == 'd' && !f.isDirectory) return@forEach
398:             val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(start) ?: return@forEach
399:             val path = if (rel.path == ".") start.name else start.name + "/" + rel.path
400:             if (namePattern == null || globMatch(namePattern, rel.path) || globMatch(namePattern, f.name)) {
401:                 out.append(path).append('\n')
402:             }
403:         }
404:         return Result(0, out.toString())
405:     }

407:     private fun shellGrep(args: List<String>, dir: File, stdin: String): Result {
408:         val ignoreCase = args.any { it == "-i" }
409:         val rest = args.filter { it != "-i" && it != "-n" && !it.startsWith("-") }
410:         if (rest.isEmpty()) return Result(1, "grep: использование: grep [-i] <шаблон> [файл]\n")
411:         val pattern = try {
412:             if (ignoreCase) Regex(rest[0], RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE) else Regex(rest[0])
413:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
414:             return Result(2, "grep: плохой regex: ${t.message}\n")
415:         }
416:         val text = if (rest.size > 1) {
417:             sandboxPath(rest[1], dir)?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
418:                 ?: return Result(1, "grep: ${rest[1]}: нет такого файла\n")
419:         } else stdin
420:         val out = StringBuilder()
421:         text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
422:             if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("%d:%s\n".format(idx + 1, line))
423:         }
424:         return Result(if (out.isEmpty()) 1 else 0, out.toString())
425:     }

477:     /**
478:      * A minimal `npm` for the sandbox: init creates package.json, install
479:      * downloads pure-JS packages (into the shared store, which require()
480:      * already resolves), run executes package.json scripts through this shell.
481:      */
482:     private fun npm(args: List<String>, dir: File, timeoutMs: Long): Result {
483:         val sub = args.firstOrNull() ?: return Result(1, "npm: нужна подкоманда: init, install, run, test, ls\n")
484:         val rest = args.drop(1)
485:         return try {
486:             when (sub) {
487:                 "init" -> npmInit(rest, dir)
488:                 "install", "i", "add" -> npmInstall(rest, dir)
489:                 "run" -> npmRun(rest, dir, timeoutMs)
490:                 "test" -> npmRun(listOf("test"), dir, timeoutMs)
491:                 "ls", "list" -> npmLs(dir)
492:                 "--version", "-v" -> Result(0, "npm (PocketRun) — init / install / run / test / ls\n")
493:                 else -> Result(1, "npm: неизвестная подкоманда '$sub' (есть: init, install, run, test, ls)\n")
494:             }
495:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
496:             Result(1, "npm: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}\n")
497:         }
498:     }

500:     private fun npmInit(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
501:         val pkg = File(dir, "package.json")
502:         if (pkg.isFile && args.none { it == "-y" || it == "--yes" || it == "-f" || it == "--force" }) {
503:             return Result(1, "npm: package.json уже существует (npm init -y чтобы перезаписать)\n")
504:         }
505:         val json = org.json.JSONObject()
506:             .put("name", dir.name.replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9-]"), "-").trim('-').ifEmpty { "project" })
507:             .put("version", "1.0.0")
508:             .put("description", "")
509:             .put("main", "index.js")
510:             .put(
511:                 "scripts",
512:                 org.json.JSONObject().put("test", "echo \"Error: no test specified\" && exit 1"),
513:             )
514:         pkg.writeText(json.toString(2) + "\n", Charsets.UTF_8)
515:         return Result(0, "создан package.json (${json.optString("name")})\n")
516:     }
517: 
518:     private fun npmInstall(args: List<String>, dir: File): Result {
519:         val pkg = File(dir, "package.json")

113:                     val text = response.content.orEmpty()

115:                     if (text.isNotBlank()) onEvent(Event.AssistantText(text))
116:                     return finish(full)
117:                 }
118: 
119:                 val assistantMsg = JSONObject().put("role", "assistant")
120:                 if (response.content != null) {
121:                     assistantMsg.put("content", response.content)
122:                     if (response.content.isNotBlank()) onEvent(Event.AssistantText(response.content))
123:                 }
124:                 val calls = JSONArray()
125:                 response.toolCalls.forEach { call ->
126:                     calls.put(
127:                         JSONObject().apply {
128:                             put("id", call.id)
129:                             put("type", "function")
130:                             put("function", JSONObject().put("name", call.name).put("arguments", call.arguments))
131:                         },
132:                     )
133:                 }
134:                 assistantMsg.put("tool_calls", calls)
135:                 full.put(assistantMsg)
136: 
137:                 var interrupted = false
138:                 for (call in response.toolCalls) {
139:                     if (isCancelled()) {
140:                         interrupted = true
141:                         break
142:                     }
143:                     onEvent(Event.ToolStart(call.name, prettyArgs(call.arguments)))
144:                     val result = tools.execute(call.name, call.arguments)
145:                     onEvent(Event.ToolDone(call.name, result))
146:                     full.put(
147:                         JSONObject().apply {
148:                             put("role", "tool")
149:                             put("tool_call_id", call.id)
150:                             put("content", result)
151:                         },
152:                     )
153:                 }
154:                 if (interrupted) {

156:                     // repairs the tail of the history before it is saved.
157:                     onEvent(Event.Failed(CANCELLED))

167:                 )
168:             }

175:     /**

178:      * unanswered tool call is rejected by strict providers, and this history is
179:      * what the next request and the next session are built from.
180:      */

182:         val answered = mutableSetOf<String>()
183:         for (i in 0 until messages.length()) {
184:             val m = messages.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
185:             if (m.optString("role") == "tool") answered += m.optString("tool_call_id")
186:         }
187:         for (i in messages.length() - 1 downTo 0) {
188:             val m = messages.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
189:             if (m.optString("role") != "assistant") continue
190:             val calls = m.optJSONArray("tool_calls") ?: return stripSystem(messages)
191:             for (c in 0 until calls.length()) {
192:                 val id = calls.getJSONObject(c).optString("id")
193:                 if (id.isEmpty() || id in answered) continue
194:                 messages.put(
195:                     JSONObject()
196:                         .put("role", "tool")
197:                         .put("tool_call_id", id)
198:                         .put("content", "(выполнение прервано — ход остановлен)"),
199:                 )
200:             }
201:             break
202:         }
203:         return stripSystem(messages)
204:     }
205: 
206:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- prompt
207: 
208:     private fun systemMessage(): JSONObject {
209:         // instructions (AGENTS.md etc.) for the current project
210:         val instr = Instructions(workspace).collect(projectDir)
211:         val todosBlock = if (tools.todos.isEmpty()) {
212:             "No todos yet."
213:         } else {
214:             tools.todos.joinToString("\n") { "  - [${it.status}] ${it.content}" }
215:         }
216: 
217:         val prompt = buildString {
218:             appendLine("You are opencode, an AI coding agent running inside the PocketRun app on Android. You help with code and files in the user's sandbox.")
219:             appendLine()
220:             appendLine("# Environment")

222:             appendLine("- Sandbox root: the workspace; nothing outside it is accessible.")

230:             appendLine("- `webfetch` can read documentation pages.")
231:             appendLine()
232:             appendLine("# How to work")
233:             appendLine("- Explore first (list, read, glob, grep), then act (edit, write, apply_patch, bash), then verify by running code.")
234:             appendLine("- Prefer precise edits over rewriting whole files.")
235:             appendLine("- Use todowrite for multi-step tasks; keep the list current.")
236:             appendLine("- Ask the user with the question tool when requirements are ambiguous.")
237:             appendLine("- If a tool fails, read the error and adjust; do not repeat the same failing call more than twice.")
238:             appendLine("- Keep going until the task is actually done: you have up to $maxSteps model rounds for this request, and long builds and downloads are normal — plan for them instead of stopping early.")
239:             appendLine("- When you must wait for something (a CI run, a build), block on a single waiting call (github run_wait) instead of polling in a loop: polling wastes rounds.")
240:             appendLine("- For workflows the user repeats, suggest saving a skill: a folder .opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with `name` and `description` in YAML frontmatter — you can create it with apply_patch yourself, then load it with the skill tool.")
241:             appendLine("- Answer in the user's language (usually Russian). Be concise; show what you did.")
242:             if (askMode) {
243:                 appendLine()
244:                 appendLine("# Clarification mode (user preference)")
245:                 appendLine("Before any non-trivial task, ask the user 1-3 short clarifying questions with the question tool (each with concrete answer options). Only proceed automatically when the request is completely unambiguous or you already asked in this session.")
246:             }
247:             if (hasGitHub) {
248:                 appendLine()
249:                 appendLine("# GitHub and Actions runners")
250:                 appendLine("The `github` tool talks to the GitHub REST API with the user's token. GitHub Actions runners are full Linux machines (ubuntu-latest): use them for anything the mobile sandbox cannot run — npm packages, opencode itself, compilers, heavy tests.")
251:                 appendLine("Runner pattern:")
252:                 appendLine("1. repo_create (private by default) → 2. push code + .github/workflows/run.yml (one commit, atomically) → 3. dispatch → 4. github run_wait {repo, timeout_sec} — blocks until the run finishes and returns the conclusion, the jobs and the log tail → 5. artifacts/artifact_download.")
253:                 appendLine("Never poll `runs` in a loop: run_wait is one round instead of ten, and it works for anything that takes minutes.")
254:                 appendLine("Example workflow the user can adapt:")
255:                 appendLine("```yaml")
256:                 appendLine("name: agent-runner")
257:                 appendLine("on: workflow_dispatch")
258:                 appendLine("jobs:")
259:                 appendLine("  run:")
260:                 appendLine("    runs-on: ubuntu-latest")
261:                 appendLine("    steps:")
262:                 appendLine("      - uses: actions/checkout@v4")
263:                 appendLine("      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4")
264:                 appendLine("        with: { node-version: 22 }")
265:                 appendLine("      - run: npm install")
266:                 appendLine("      # opencode inside the runner:")
267:                 appendLine("      - run: npm i -g opencode-ai && opencode run --model opencode/claude-sonnet-4-5 \"<task>\"")
268:                 appendLine("        env: { OPENCODE_API_KEY: '${'$'}{{ secrets.ZEN_KEY }}' }")
269:                 appendLine("      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4")
270:                 appendLine("        with: { name: out, path: out/ }")
271:                 appendLine("```")
272:                 appendLine("Never print or commit the user's tokens; reference secrets like \${{ secrets.NAME }} instead.")
273:             }
274:             appendLine()
275:             appendLine("# Current todos")
276:             appendLine(todosBlock)
277:             if (instr.text.isNotEmpty()) {
278:                 appendLine()
279:                 appendLine("# Instructions")
280:                 appendLine(instr.text)
281:             }
282:         }
283:         return JSONObject().put("role", "system").put("content", prompt.trim())
284:     }
285: 
286:     private fun stripSystem(messages: JSONArray): JSONArray {
287:         val out = JSONArray()
288:         for (i in 0 until messages.length()) {
289:             val m = messages.get(i)
290:             if (m is JSONObject && m.optString("role") == "system") continue
291:             out.put(m)
292:         }
293:         return out
294:     }
295: 
296:     private fun prettyArgs(argsJson: String): String = try {
297:         val obj = JSONObject(argsJson)
298:         if (obj.length() == 0) "" else obj.toString().take(200)
299:     } catch (t: Throwable) {
300:         argsJson.take(200)
301:     }
302: }

import java.io.File

/**
 * The opencode agent loop: user message in, tool calls out, tool results back
 * in, repeat until a plain-text answer (or the round budget). The system prompt
 * is assembled opencode-style: base agent prompt + AGENTS.md instructions +
 * current todos; skills are advertised through the `skill` tool description.
 *
 * Long turns are the normal case, not the exception, so the loop is built for
 * them: the answer is streamed (so the connection never goes idle and ⏹ works),
 * the history is trimmed before every request (so the prompt stays inside the
 * model's context), and a turn that runs out of rounds is saved instead of lost
 * — the user continues it with `/continue`.
 */

289:     /** True when the call cannot change anything (auto-approved in manual mode). */
290:     fun isReadOnly(name: String, args: JSONObject): Boolean = when (name) {
291:         "read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch", "skill", "question", "todowrite" -> true
292:         "github" -> args.optString("op") in GitHubClient.READ_OPS
293:         else -> false
294:     }
295: 
296:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools
297: 
298:     private fun base(): File = projectDir ?: workspace.root
299: 
300:     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
301:         val command = args.getString("command")
302:         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
303:         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
304:         val out = buildString {
305:             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
306:             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
307:         }
308:         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
309:     }
310: 
311:     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
312:         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
313:         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
314:         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
315:         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
316:         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
317:         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
318:         val lines = text.lines()
319:         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
320:         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
321:         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
322:         val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
323:         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
324:             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
325:     }

327:     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
328:         val path = args.getString("filePath")
329:         if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
330:         val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
331:         f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
332:         f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
333:         return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
334:     }

336:     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
337:         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
338:         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
339:         val old = args.getString("oldString")
340:         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
341:         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
342:         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
343:         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
344:         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
345:         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
346:             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
347:         }
348:         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
349:         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
350:         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
351:     }

353:     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
354:         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
355:         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
356:         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
357:         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
358:         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
359:         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
360:         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
361:     }
362: 
363:     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
364:         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
365:         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
366:         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
367:         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
368:         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
369:             if (f.isFile) {
370:                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
371:                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
372:             }
373:         }
374:         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
375:         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
376:             .take(200)
377:             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
378:     }
379: 
380:     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
381:         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
382:         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
383:         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
384:         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
385:         val out = StringBuilder()
386:         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
387:             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
388:             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
389:             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
390:             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
391:             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
392:             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
393:                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
394:             }
395:         }
396:         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
397:     }
398: 
399:     private fun doApplyPatch(args: JSONObject): String {
400:         return try {
401:             val result = ApplyPatch.apply(args.getString("patchText")) { path -> resolve(path) }
402:             buildString {
403:                 if (result.applied.isNotEmpty()) appendLine(result.applied.joinToString("\n"))
404:                 if (result.skipped.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("skipped: " + result.skipped.joinToString("; "))
405:             }.trim().ifEmpty { "патч не содержал операций" }
406:         } catch (e: ApplyPatch.PatchException) {
407:             "error: ${e.message}"
408:         }
409:     }

411:     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
412:         val arr = args.optJSONArray("todos") ?: return "error: нужен массив todos"
413:         val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
414:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
415:             val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
416:             val content = o.optString("content")
417:             if (content.isEmpty()) continue
418:             val status = o.optString("status", "pending")
419:             list += Sessions.Todo(
420:                 id = o.optString("id").ifEmpty { "t$i" },
421:                 content = content,
422:                 status = if (status in listOf("pending", "in_progress", "completed")) status else "pending",
423:             )
424:         }
425:         todos = list
426:         onTodos?.invoke(list)
427:         return "todos updated: ${list.size}"
428:     }

430:     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
431:         val url = args.getString("url")
432:         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
433:         return try {
434:             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
435:             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
436:             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
437:             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
438:             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
439:             val status = conn.responseCode
440:             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
441:                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
442:             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
443:             val text = stripHtml(body)
444:             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
445:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
446:             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
447:         }
448:     }

450:     private fun doSkill(args: JSONObject): String {

452:         val skill = skills.load(name, projectDir)
453:             ?: return "error: навык '$name' не найден. Доступны: ${skills.discover(projectDir).joinToString(", ") { it.name }.ifEmpty { "(нет)" }}"
454:         return skill.content.take(32 * 1024)

457:     private fun doQuestion(args: JSONObject): String {

477:         }
